tier1.headline: Your Data Shared Commercially
tier1.quote: When you view on-demand video on our websites, we may collect your viewing and usage information, and we may share information that identifies you as having viewed particular video content with service providers that enable video functionality, personalization, and usage analysis and third parties for advertising and marketing, as well as editorial purposes.

tier1.headline: Your Data Trains AI
tier1.quote: Create a profile of your publication record based on publicly available data, such as published books and articles, citations and grants awarded.

tier2.headline: Your Data Shared Internally
tier2.quote: Provide access (where appropriate) to other Springer Nature group content if you so request

tier2.headline: Your Data Retained Long-Term
tier2.quote: Non-activity is defined at a minimum of three years, to facilitate ease-of-return for account holders.

tier2.headline: Your Location Data Collected
tier2.quote: This includes a device's IP address (processed during your session and stored in a de-identified form), device screen size, device type (unique device identifiers), browser information, geographic location (country only), and the preferred language used to display our website.

tier2.headline: Your Behavior Is Profiled
tier2.quote: We use Hotjar in order to better understand our users' needs and to optimize our service and experience.

tier2.headline: Your Data Used For Ads
tier2.quote: Furthermore, your personal data will be used to provide you with relevant advertising for our services and products (see VII) and for statistical analysis that helps us to improve our website (see VIII).

tier2.headline: Your Data Transferred Globally
tier2.quote: Your personal data may be transferred to and processed inside and outside of the EEA.

tier2.headline: Your Data Disclosed To Authorities
tier2.quote: It is possible that the above providers may disclose your personal data to its business partners, third parties or authorities.

tier2.headline: Your Deletion Rights Limited
tier2.quote: Statutory storage obligations or the need for legal actions that may arise from misconduct within the services or payment problems can lead to a longer retention of your personal data.
